title: Proofreading vs Editing vs Copywriting: Which Do You Need?
h1: Proofreading vs editing vs copywriting: which do you need?
description: The difference between proofreading, editing, copywriting and content writing, what each changes, and how to pick the right writing service for your text.
intro: Writing services are easy to confuse. Proofreading, editing, copywriting and content writing all involve words, but they start from different points and change different things. Asking a proofreader to make your sales page more persuasive, or asking a copywriter to fix a few typos, leads to disappointment and wasted money. This article explains what each service does and how to choose.

faq.q: What is the difference between proofreading and editing?
faq.a: Proofreading fixes surface errors. Editing improves clarity, structure and flow, and may change sentences.

faq.q: Is copywriting the same as content writing?
faq.a: Not quite. Copywriting aims to persuade people to act; content writing aims to inform or engage.

faq.q: Can one freelancer do all of these?
faq.a: Some can, but many specialize. Choose someone whose portfolio matches the work you need.
